```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def record(x, y, label, css_class):
    return [
        f'  <rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="82" height="54" class="{css_class}"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 41}" y="{y + 36}" text-anchor="middle" class="record-label">{label}</text>',
    ]


def relation(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    return f'  <line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" class="relation"/>'


width, height = 1600, 820
svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Cardinalitats 1 a 1, N a 1, 1 a N i N a M</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Quatre esquemes mostren parelles úniques, molts centres associats a un municipi, moltes observacions associades a un municipi i una relació entre equipaments i serveis resolta amb una taula intermèdia.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    '      .panel { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c5d0d5; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .heading { fill: #21313c; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .side { fill: #5b6d76; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .note { fill: #40545e; font-size: 28px; }',
    '      .left-record { fill: #dceef4; stroke: #2878a5; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .right-record { fill: #f5e5d8; stroke: #b65c35; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .pair-record { fill: #e5efe7; stroke: #3d7e5c; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .record-label { fill: #243640; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .relation { stroke: #6b7b82; stroke-width: 3; }',
    '      .warning { fill: #a53b2b; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '    </style>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <rect width="1600" height="820" fill="#f7f9fa"/>',
]

panel_x = [20, 415, 810, 1205]
for x in panel_x:
    svg.append(f'  <rect x="{x}" y="25" width="375" height="770" class="panel"/>')

# 1:1
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="207" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">1 : 1</text>',
    '  <text x="91" y="125" text-anchor="middle" class="side">municipi</text>',
    '  <text x="324" y="125" text-anchor="middle" class="side">fitxa vigent</text>',
])
for index, label in enumerate(("M1", "M2", "M3")):
    y = 175 + index * 145
    svg.extend(record(50, y, label, "left-record"))
    svg.extend(record(283, y, f"F{index + 1}", "right-record"))
    svg.append(relation(132, y + 27, 283, y + 27))
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="207" y="665" text-anchor="middle" class="note">una candidata única</text>',
    '  <text x="207" y="700" text-anchor="middle" class="note">per fila objectiu</text>',
    '  <text x="207" y="748" text-anchor="middle" class="side">unió directa</text>',
])

# N:1
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="602" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">N : 1</text>',
    '  <text x="486" y="125" text-anchor="middle" class="side">centres</text>',
    '  <text x="719" y="125" text-anchor="middle" class="side">municipi</text>',
])
for index in range(3):
    y = 175 + index * 145
    svg.extend(record(445, y, f"C{index + 1}", "left-record"))
    svg.append(relation(527, y + 27, 678, 347))
svg.extend(record(678, 320, "M1", "right-record"))
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="602" y="665" text-anchor="middle" class="note">cada centre troba</text>',
    '  <text x="602" y="700" text-anchor="middle" class="note">un sol municipi</text>',
    '  <text x="602" y="748" text-anchor="middle" class="side">files objectiu conservades</text>',
])

# 1:N
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="997" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">1 : N</text>',
    '  <text x="881" y="125" text-anchor="middle" class="side">municipi</text>',
    '  <text x="1170" y="125" text-anchor="end" class="side">observacions</text>',
])
svg.extend(record(840, 320, "M1", "left-record"))
for index in range(3):
    y = 175 + index * 145
    svg.extend(record(1073, y, f"O{index + 1}", "right-record"))
    svg.append(relation(922, 347, 1073, y + 27))
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="997" y="650" text-anchor="middle" class="note">una unió plana pot</text>',
    '  <text x="997" y="685" text-anchor="middle" class="warning">repetir la geometria</text>',
    '  <text x="997" y="748" text-anchor="middle" class="side">relació o agregació</text>',
])

# N:M through a relation table.
svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1392" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">N : M</text>',
    '  <text x="1220" y="125" text-anchor="start" class="side">equipaments</text>',
    '  <text x="1528" y="125" text-anchor="middle" class="side">serveis</text>',
])
svg.extend(record(1225, 210, "E1", "left-record"))
svg.extend(record(1225, 455, "E2", "left-record"))
svg.extend(record(1497, 210, "S1", "right-record"))
svg.extend(record(1497, 455, "S2", "right-record"))
pair_rows = [("E1·S1", 185), ("E1·S2", 320), ("E2·S2", 455)]
for label, y in pair_rows:
    svg.extend(record(1360, y, label, "pair-record"))
svg.extend([
    relation(1307, 237, 1360, 212),
    relation(1442, 212, 1497, 237),
    relation(1307, 237, 1360, 347),
    relation(1442, 347, 1497, 482),
    relation(1307, 482, 1360, 482),
    relation(1442, 482, 1497, 482),
    '  <text x="1392" y="650" text-anchor="middle" class="note">una fila per parella</text>',
    '  <text x="1392" y="685" text-anchor="middle" class="note">admesa</text>',
    '  <text x="1392" y="748" text-anchor="middle" class="side">taula intermèdia</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/05-consultes-dades-relacionals/join-cardinality.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
